newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power again raises off-peak prices.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power again raises off-peak prices.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised its next-day offer for both firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours by $1.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) to $15.00 and $14.00, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA had previously raised firm off-peak prices by $1.00 on Tuesday.
Prices for peak-hour sales between 0800 and 2100 PDT were unchanged at $20.00 per MWh ($19.00 non-firm).
Bonneville had been limiting sales during these hours to 200 MW, but no limits were placed on Thursday pre-schedulings.
Shoulder hour prices were still split between $16.00 for hours ending 0600 and 2400 ($15.00 non-firm) and $18.00 for hours ending 0700, 2200 and 2300 ($17.00 non-firm).
